targets.behavior: Schema-v15 group-only definitions round-trip deterministically, schemas 12 through 14 migrate in memory, and unsupported legacy or future versions fail explicitly.

Malformed definitions, missing geometry, and invalid routes are reported deterministically; strict routing rejects undersized apertures while product preview and generation warn and preserve cable spacing outside them.
Ordered crossings, smooth fairing, crowded spans, and bend-safe Sweep scenarios remain deterministic.
Harness defaults and per-cable material, diameter, appearance, and stripe overrides resolve correctly.
Cable routes, pathway occupancy, connection use, and diagram projections cross-check by stable identity.
Editing, search, collapse state, diagram navigation, diagnostics, and dialog rollback behave at the web boundary.
Fusion creates, persists, rediscovers, previews, and generates the deterministic reference harness.
Every feasible routing fixture produces one native solid Sweep and infeasible fixtures fail preflight.
Preview, clear, save, close, reopen, and clear again leave no cached or orphaned Custom Graphics.
Generate, rebuild, transform, and clear preserve cable identity and keep stripes owned by their generated components.

Every persistent edit, Preview, Generate, Rebuild, and Clear Solids operation creates one reversible Fusion history action with stable Undo/Redo results; transient Clear Preview removes graphics immediately.
Repeated add-in stop and start cycles remove and restore commands, palettes, handlers, previews, and package modules cleanly.
targets.manualReason: Fusion 2704.1.53 crashed during the second Application.scripts stop/start cycle inside one MCP-hosted script. Repeated host-owned cycles through Scripts and Add-Ins passed on the current macOS host.
targets.reviewTrigger: Retry automation only after Autodesk exposes a stable host-owned lifecycle boundary or a later Fusion release materially changes Application.scripts behavior.

targets.behavior: Deleted or invalid profile references survive reload as repairable findings without damaging healthy definitions.
Palette hover and diagram scopes select the intended root-context profiles, gates, and generated cable bodies.
Cable stripes conform to curved solids, remain centered, and retain useful contrast at representative viewpoints.
Native and HTML dialogs open within their bounds with readable controls and no unintended scrollbars.
Assembly-mode creation places and persists one external harness component in the selected cloud folder.
Platform-independent and Fusion-host verification produce equivalent results on Windows.
targets.manualReason: No Windows test machine is currently available; portable implementation rules remain active in the meantime.
targets.reviewTrigger: Activate the Windows suite when a suitable physical or virtual Windows Fusion host becomes available.
